common_samples = list(set(counts_df.index) & set(metadata_df.index))
print(f"Common samples: {len(common_samples)}", file=sys.stderr)
counts_df = counts_df.loc[common_samples]
metadata_df = metadata_df.loc[common_samples]

metadata_df['batch'] = metadata_df['batch'].astype(str)
metadata_df['sex'] = metadata_df['sex'].astype(str)

sex_levels = sorted(metadata_df['sex'].unique())
print(f"Sex levels: {sex_levels}", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"Batch levels: {sorted(metadata_df['batch'].unique())}", file=sys.stderr)

    counts=counts_df,
    metadata=metadata_df,
    design_factors='batch + sex',
)
